Name: Yumiko's Extra Crops
Author: SakakiYumiko
Description: Created custom assets for Mustard seeds, flowers, and Dijon Mustard. Mustard Seeds are available in winter from the seed shop. To create mustard, simply add 5 mustard seeds and 1 bottle of cheap wine to the Preserves Jar and wait 4 days!

Downloads.Description: Adds Mustard seeds, the ability to create Dijon Mustard, and Deviled Eggs.

Manifest.Name: Yumiko's Extra Crops
Manifest.Description: Adds Mustard seeds to the game; a wintertime crop that allows for the creation of Dijon Mustard in a Preserves Jar.
